description:
This unique full-floor flat is part of a small historic building designed by Julia Morgan in the best neighborhood steps away from Fillmore and Divisadero Streets. Enter the gated front yard and find a peaceful outdoor space hidden in the City's best neighborhood. Hand-carved woodwork, 11' ceilings and other charming features from 140 years ago were retained while the home was updated for current living with new cabinets, counters, appliances, Ann Sacks tile, Jonathan Adler Lighting, full size in-unit laundry machines, intercom, allergen-free radiant heating (no banging radiators) and high-speed Sonic fiber internet. There is lots of light from all four sides because of the detached building.  The home has its own private entrance, room for bike storage, security cameras and a secure area for packages. The apartment can be used as a 2 or 3 bedroom unit depending on if the dining room and office are used as bedrooms. There is room for desks in each bedroom and a dining area in the living room. There are 2 full bathrooms.
Street parking is easy on this block with a $215 annual permit.  Walk 1-2 flat blocks to Alta Plaza Park, Mollie Stone Grocery, B Patisserie, Routier, Pizzeria Delfina, Tailor's Son, Florio or Sweet Maple.  Japantown and the Presidio are a short walk away.  The owner lives on-site and is available as needs arise. Available for 12 months or more. The express 1 California bus line is 1/2 block away and Lyft cars are easy to get at all hours. If you'd like to see the apartment, please say when you are available.  Photos show the home when it was staged.  Three people maximum occupancy.

I will be traveling from May 18 to November 30, 2026 (end date flexible) and am renting out my 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath entire single family home with 2-car garage and electric charger in the north slope of Bernal Heights, San Francisco.
Built in 1998, extensively updated in 2018 and 2021, the first floor has 2 bedrooms (1 currently set up as a home office) with a shared balcony and a full bathroom with tub. The second floor consists of an open plan living, dining, & kitchen area with a fireplace, an adjacent breakfast nook and a guest half bath. The chef's kitchen comes w/ a breakfast bar and a spacious breakfast area with 3 skylights and huge windows overlooking the furnished back patio and succulent garden. The top floor houses a luxurious primary suite with a wood burning Carrara marble fireplace surround, a deck & panoramic views of downtown San Francisco, East Bay, Sutro, Bernal Heights and Golden Gate Bridge on a clear day. The spa retreat bathroom has a glass enclosed wet room.
On the ground floor there is a 2 car garage with built-in storage, laundry hookups and an extra storage room. Close to Precita Park, shops of Cortland and transit. The neighbors are very friendly and helpful to boot! Asking for $2,500/week. Must pass credit check. Serious inquiries only!
